identity: Conduct observation of the moon and study astrological charts to develop a corpus of research for lesser mysteries.  You must be outdoors at night to conduct your research.

identity: I'm ready to become a true cyborg.

identity:
&Doc Stevens ties down your limbs, and gives you a firm nod.  Then he wipes his brow, again.  And then again with the other sleeve.  The bone saw quickens until it is spinning with a deafening sound.  Its biting teeth cut the air with a harsh whistle.  "Hoowee, it's hot today.  Alright, give me just a second to boot up the twilight juice, yeah?  Stay still!".

<color_red>You have a VERY bad feeling about this.</color>

identity: This Exodii is named Venn.  You've met before.  Venn and the Autodoc will do some serious work on you.  They'll take out all of your important organs and stick them in a Cyberframe, like these.  It will take a long time.  We can offer you one of two basic Cyberframes.  If your mind is set on doing this, you can pick.
